description: CrewCheck: crew health when Earth is far away. Near Earth, a flight surgeon answers in seconds; on the way to Mars, a reply takes up to 20 minutes each way. CrewCheck collects vitals automatically from a wearable, needs under a minute of input a day, and shows each crew member on a living body map. For every signal it says who acts: the astronaut, the crew medical officer, or Earth. AI advises, rules decide. We have built personal health software before. Teammates welcome.
